description: The donut chart illustrates the distribution of samples (%) across different levels of sample-level ambiguity, categorized by two metrics: ambiguity standard deviation (outer ring) and maximum ambiguity (inner ring). The outer ring, labeled "Ambiguity Std (Outer)," is segmented into four distinct blue-toned slices representing standard deviation values of 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94, with corresponding percentages of 49.0%, 47.7%, 7.0%, and 5.0% respectively. The inner ring, labeled "Max Ambiguity (Inner)," consists of three lighter blue slices corresponding to maximum ambiguity values of 1, 2, and 3, with percentages of 39.0%, 38.0%, and 14.2% respectively. The chart includes a legend on the right side that maps each color to its specific value for both metrics, and the percentage for each segment is clearly labeled within the respective slice. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest segments appearing in the upper left portion of the chart.
